{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-15 notes that PK subgroup visits V2.1 (Day 2), V2.2 (Day 6, ±1d), V2.3 (Day 10, ±1d), V7.1 (Day 72), V7.2 (Day 76), V7.3 (Day 80, ±1d), and V8.1 (Day 90, ±2d) are missing from the current EDC build, and no operations in the diff add these events or assign the PK form to them. In addition, the 480 h PK timepoint (collected at Day 90 / V8.1 per p. 27 and p. 45) is missing from the PKTPT codelist."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-05",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-05 creates the Anti-TJ301 Antibodies (ADA) form and assigns it only to Visit 3, whereas Table 1 (p. 45) and Sections 6.2.3, 6.2.4, and 6.3 (pp. 50, 52) require ADA blood sampling at Visits 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, and 9. Because no ADA form previously existed in the casebook, omitting V2, V4, V6, V8, and V9 misses required immunogenicity data at five visits."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-09",
      "change_id": "CH-19",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-09 creates the Patient Diary Dispensing and Review form and assigns it only to Visit 2, whereas Table 1 (p. 44) requires diary dispensing at Visits 1, 1.1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 and diary review at Visits 1.1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8. Because no diary form existed in the casebook, assigning it only to V2 leaves all other required visits uncollected and asks a dispensing question at V8 and a review question at V1 if simply expanded."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34), Table 1 footnote c (p. 45), and Section 6.2.2 (p. 49, first bullet) state the screening endoscopy should be performed Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, which OP-10 enforces, but Section 6.2.2 on p. 49 also states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable' (an apparent holdover from V1.0's Day -60 window). A reviewer must confirm whether endoscopies between Day -60 and Day -36 should be queried as ineligible."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-11",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-11 adds an edit check firing whenever hours_between(EX.EXSTDTC, EX.EXENDTC) != 2, enforcing an exact 2-hour duration (or integer-hour comparison) that is stricter than the V1.0 tolerance (2 hours ± 3 min) that CH-13 removed specifically because 'For some sites, it may be difficult to control the dosing time within ±3 min' (p. 94). Enforcing exact equality to 2 hours contradicts the amendment's intent to relax the ±3 minute dosing time restriction."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-12",
      "change_id": "CH-15",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "According to Table 1 footnote e (p. 45) and Figure 5 (p. 47), ALL PK blood sampling—including pre-dose, 0.5, 1, 2, 6, 336, and 840 h—is 'For Mainland China PK subgroup only', yet OP-12 restricts only 48 h, 144 h, and 240 h to PKSUB = 'Yes' (and scopes the check to V2, V7, V8 even though those samples occur on PK visits V2.1–V2.3 and V7.1–V7.3). Furthermore, the protocol contains an internal inconsistency between Table 1/Section 6.2.5 (PK for 24-patient Mainland China subgroup only) and Section 9.6.3 (p. 68: 'For all patients, serum peak and trough (pre-infusion) TJ301 concentrations over time will be presented')."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-12",
      "change_id": "CH-4",
      "page": 27,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-12 references $V2.RAND.PKSUB != 'Yes' (consent to PK substudy) and scopes the rule to events V2, V7, and V8, but its cited quote on p. 27 only lists the 1st-dose PK sampling hours and does not mention consent stratification or Visits 2, 7, and 8."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "I could not verify whether criterion-level eligibility items (for CH-9 and CH-11) or physical examination forms (for CH-18) are captured in external modules or omitted intentionally, nor could I verify the exact runtime semantics of hours_between and days_between in the target EDC rule engine."
}
